page_title: WallpaperMachine — Wallpaper Engine. Meet your Mac.

summary.name: WallpaperMachine
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native macOS app that plays Wallpaper Engine scene, video and web wallpapers on your Mac, with Steam Workshop browsing and downloads built in.
use_cases: Play Wallpaper Engine wallpapers on a Mac
Download Steam Workshop wallpapers without a Windows PC
Set different wallpapers on each display
Animate the lock screen with a video or scene wallpaper
Make wallpapers react to music playing on the Mac
Reduce battery use with paused or lower-frame-rate wallpapers
summary.what_it_does: WallpaperMachine is a native macOS client for Wallpaper Engine wallpapers, supporting scene, video and web wallpaper types. It includes Steam Workshop browsing and downloads, which use Valve's SteamCMD on the Mac, so no Windows program runs. Each display can have its own wallpaper, or mirror another, with its own scaling, frame rate and volume. Battery options can pause wallpapers or lower render scale and frame rate, and sleep or lock pauses them all. Optional audio response and media integration let some wallpapers move with music or show the current song, and an experimental setting can play a wallpaper on the lock screen. Existing Wallpaper Engine folders can be imported.
notable: Native macOS client with Steam Workshop browsing and downloads built in, no Windows required
Per-display wallpapers with independent scaling, frame rate and volume
Fully open source under GPL-2.0 on GitHub
Experimental animated lock screen (macOS 26 Tahoe or later)
caveats: Requires Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 15 Sequoia or later; Intel Macs are not supported
Workshop downloads need a Steam account that owns Wallpaper Engine; scene wallpapers need shared resources from a purchased Wallpaper Engine installation
Compatibility varies by wallpaper; not every Workshop item renders identically
Not affiliated with Wallpaper Engine or Valve; lock screen animation relies on private macOS interfaces that an update can change
